evals.fixture: a repo with pending changes: a bug fix with its test in src/auth/, an unrelated config tweak, and a README edit
assertions: State is gathered with git status, git diff HEAD, and git log --oneline -5 in a single parallel message
The changes are grouped into separate commits: the fix with its test, the config change, and the docs change are never combined
Grouping is decided autonomously; the user is not asked how to group
Each message uses type(scope): subject with a What: and Why: body, and a Severity: trailer on the fix
git add -A and git add . are never used; files are named explicitly

evals.fixture: a repo keeping docs/decisions.md and docs/contracts.md, where the diff changes a function named as a contract's guarantee site and the commit body carries a Considered: alternative
assertions: The Considered: choice is evaluated against the promotion test and, if it qualifies, written as a D- entry to the matching area of docs/decisions.md, dated and sourced to the commit hash
The touched guarantee site gets a typed verdict: holds, broken, or needs-verify, with broken surfacing the relied-on sites as follow-up
Ledger and contract updates are committed as their own docs(decisions)/docs(contracts) commits, not folded into the code commit

evals.prompt: Commit my changes. Another agent has unrelated pending edits. The home instructions require explicit push requests and branch consent. What work is staged, is a push made, and may the skill switch branches?
evals.fixture: a scratch repo with task-owned and unrelated pending files; current branch remains unchanged
assertions: Only task-owned changes are explicitly staged
No push is made from a commit request alone
No branch change is made without required consent; existing granted authorization is preserved
